name: Eltus Ferikus Pleristus Zzetchus
desc: Eltus Ferikus Pleristus Zzetchus is a Kyrsan NPC. They guard the wind gate that leads to the entrance of the [Firfire Caverns](location:firfire_caverns) at [Firfire](location:firfire), which they will unlock only after returning the Spear of Nakti to [Erosius Amaltus Urivortus Alistus Casius Walistoshus](entity:erosius_amaltus_urivortus_alistus_casius_walistoshus).
